summary: In Basel-Stadt the annual resident parking permit rose from CHF 140 to CHF 284 at the start of 2019, and in September 2021 voters rejected an initiative to reverse the 2019 increase in parking fees. Since 1 January 2025 resident permit fees depend on vehicle length, with a second increase announced for 2027, and in October 2025 the government presented a concept for neighbourhood garages to move street parking onto private land; the municipality bought the Horburg garage from Novartis in December 2024. Parking Kunstmuseum opened in December 2021 with 350 spaces, linked to a requirement to remove 210 nearby street spaces.

items.text: At the start of 2019 the annual resident parking permit (Anwohnerparkkarte) rose from CHF 140 to CHF 284, and since 2019 residents have been limited to one permit per person. The cantonal transport department told a parliamentary committee that both changes reduced permit numbers.
items.source_title: Bericht der Petitionskommission zur Petition P492 «Keine Gebührenwillkür in BS! Nein zu überhöhten Parkkartengebühren»

items.text: From 1 November 2019 the cantonal garages City, Steinen and Elisabethen started their cheaper evening rate of CHF 2 per hour at 17:00, two hours earlier than before; the daytime rate stayed at CHF 3 per hour. The change was introduced for an initial period of two years.

In January 2021 the canton's police launched the ParkSmart Basel app for cashless, per-minute payment at parking meters and for buying blue-zone visitor permits, with a reminder before parking time runs out. Paying with coins at the meter and buying visitor permits online or at BVB ticket machines remained possible.

In April 2021 the cantonal parliament approved CHF 11.4 million as a conditionally repayable, interest-free loan so that IWB could install and operate 200 neighbourhood charging stations (170 AC and 30 DC) by 2026. According to the report, parliament also referred to the government a motion asking for a further 2,000 charge points in publicly accessible garages.
Voters in Basel-Stadt rejected the TCS/ACS initiative «für erschwingliche Parkgebühren», which sought to reverse the 2019 increase in public parking fees, with about 56% voting no.
items.source_title: Abstimmungen Basel-Stadt - In Basel wird das billige Parkieren nicht noch billiger

items.text: Parking Kunstmuseum at St. Alban-Graben opened in mid-December 2021 with 350 spaces on four levels, open around the clock and with EV charging. It was built by Implenia for a Credit Suisse Asset Management real estate fund.

A 2013 parliamentary decision required at least 210 street spaces within about 500 m to be removed for good in return for Parking Kunstmuseum, but by the end of May 2022 only 104 had been. A parliamentary committee and the transport department agreed that 70 more would go by the end of 2022, with other solutions for the remaining 36.
items.source_title: UVEK und BVD einigen sich über Kompensation für das Parking Kunstmuseum

items.text: The government announced that from 1 January 2025 the resident permit would depend on vehicle length: CHF 332 a year for cars under 3.90 m, CHF 422 for medium cars (previously CHF 284) and CHF 512 for cars over 4.90 m. Commuter permits were set at CHF 860, 950 and 1,040. A second step was announced for 1 January 2027, raising resident permits to CHF 380, 560 and 740.
items.source_title: Basel führt grössenabhängige Gebühren für Parkkarten ein

items.text: The June 2024 announcement said parking-meter fees would in future be set for each meter by location, nearby uses and occupancy, at four levels from CHF 1 to 4 per hour, replacing the fixed fee zones. The maximum possible rate would rise from CHF 3 to 4 per hour, which the government planned to use only at a few busy central spots such as the Birsigparkplatz or Claragraben.
items.source_title: Basel führt grössenabhängige Gebühren für Parkkarten ein

items.text: From 1 January 2025 Switzerland cut the duty-free allowance for goods bought abroad from CHF 300 to CHF 150 per person per day, a measure aimed at cross-border shopping.
items.source_title: Wertfreigrenze im Reiseverkehr wird auf 150 Franken pro Person gesenkt

items.text: In December 2024 the municipality of Basel bought the Horburg garage by the Horburgpark from Novartis, whose use of it had been limited to employees. After safety and upgrade works, one of its three sections was planned to open to long-term renters from the second quarter of 2026.
items.source_title: Anzug Salome Bessenich und Konsorten betreffend «Nutzung des Horburg-Parkings als Quartierparking» (24.5032.02)

items.text: The transport department reported that, after correcting for two recording changes, street parking fell by about 350 spaces between November 2022 and November 2024, while about 2,000 private spaces were built in 35 new buildings completed in 2023 and 2024. A first pilot for shared use of private parking, about 50 underground spaces at Hochstrasse 16 rentable through the Share-P platform, was expected to start in September 2025.
items.source_title: In Basel stehen insgesamt mehr Parkplätze zur Verfügung

items.text: The government set out plans to move street parking into neighbourhood garages (Quartierparkings): in Kleinbasel by partly converting the Novartis Klybeck garage and building one in the planned Messehalle 3 redevelopment, with further need identified in Gundeldingen/Dreispitz and around Colmarerstrasse. The Mobility Fund may pay up to 40% of construction costs, and prices are meant to follow market rates for private parking.
items.source_title: Regierungsrat will Entwicklung von Quartierparkings vorantreiben

items.text: A committee report on a TCS petition against the 2025 permit fees records the transport department's figures: street parking fell by about 2,000 to about 26,000 spaces between 2015 and 2024, compared with about 80,000 spaces on private land including public garages. The department expected about 2,000 fewer resident permits by the end of 2025 than a year earlier. The petitioners noted that the federal Price Supervisor had recommended a maximum of CHF 322 a year.
items.source_title: Bericht der Petitionskommission zur Petition P492 «Keine Gebührenwillkür in BS! Nein zu überhöhten Parkkartengebühren»

items.text: Art Basel's June 2025 fair at Messe Basel drew 88,000 visitors across preview and public days, with 289 galleries from 42 countries and territories.
items.source_title: Art Basel's 2025 edition concludes on a high note

items.text: According to the news agency SDA, Art Basel 2026 drew about 90,000 visitors from 103 countries, with 290 galleries from 43 countries.
items.source_title: Art Basel 2026 zog 90'000 Besucherinnen und Besucher an

items.text: The canton's garage page lists eight cantonal garages with about 4,300 spaces (City, Elisabethen, Steinen, St. Jakob, Storchen, ELYS, U70 and Horburg). Five of them have 22 kW chargers run with IWB and Swisscharge: City 8, Elisabethen 7, Steinen 6, St. Jakob 2 and Storchen 1.
